# Calluna xylem plot

## Libraries

```{r}
#| label: libraries
#| echo: false

library(ggplot2)
library(ggeffects)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(patchwork)
```

## Merging dataset from 2025 and 2024

### Import 2025 dataset 

```{r}
#| label: import 2025

# import dataset
data_2025 <- read.csv("clean_dataset/DURIN_clean_LygraFire_field_trait_2025.csv")
# Adding year and observer as well as oredering age_class and nin_type
data_2025 <- data_2025 %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.character("2025"),
    observer = as.character("ES"),
    age_class = factor(
      age_class, 
      levels = c("PIO", "BUI", "MAT")
    ),
    nin_type = factor(
      nin_type,
      levels = c("BH", "FH", "TH"))
  ) %>% 
  select(
    - X.1,
  )

```

### Import 2024 dataset

```{r}
#| label: import 2024

# import dataset
data_2024 <- read.csv("clean_dataset/DURIN_clean_LygraFire_field_trait_2024.csv")
# Oredering age_class and nin_type
data_2024 <- data_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.character("2024"),
    observer = as.character("LB"),
    age_class = factor(
      age_class, 
      levels = c("PIO", "BUI", "MAT")
    ),
    nin_type = factor(
      nin_type,
      levels = c("BH", "FH", "TH"))
  )

```

### Merging of both dataset

```{r}
#| label: merging of 2025 dataset with 2024 dataset

data <- bind_rows(
  data_2024,
  data_2025
)

```

```{r}
#| label: prep

data <- data |>
  group_by(treatment) |>
  mutate(means_treatment = mean(Area),
         sd_treatment = sd(Area)
         ) |> #mean areaand sd per NiN-age combination
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(plant) |>
  mutate(plant_area = mean(Area)) #mean area per plant

data <- data %>%
  arrange(desc(means_treatment)) #sort the rows in descendind order

```

## Plotting

```{r}
#| label: plot

ggplot(data, 
       aes(x = age_class, 
           y = 1, color = nin_type, 
           size = means_treatment, 
           label = round(means_treatment))) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, 
             fill = NA, 
             stroke = 2, 
             position = position_dodge(0.1)) + 
  scale_size_area(max_size = 30) + 
  geom_text(size = 4, 
            position = position_dodge(1)) + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  scale_colour_viridis_d() +
  labs(x = "Age class", 
       color = "NiN type") + 
  guides(size = "none") + 
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.title.y = element_blank())

```

```{r}
#| label: xylem area variation

variation_data <- data |>
  group_by(subset_id) |>
  mutate(subset_means = mean(Area)) |>
  distinct(subset_id, .keep_all = TRUE) 

variation_data$subset_damage <- as.character(as.numeric(variation_data$subset_damage))


xylem_variation_plot <- ggplot(data = variation_data, 
                               aes(x = age_class, 
                                   y = subset_means, 
                                   color = factor(year))) + 
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(0.1)) + 
  geom_violin(fill = NA, 
              color = "deepskyblue4") + 
  facet_grid(rows = vars(nin_type)) + 
  labs(x = "Age class", 
       y = "Mean xylem vessel area per subset in µm²",
       color = "Year") 

xylem_variation_plot
ggsave("plots/xylem_vessel_area_variation.png", xylem_variation_plot)

variation_data <- variation_data |>
  group_by(treatment) |>
  mutate(min_max = max(subset_means)-min(subset_means))
```

## Xylem vessel area

```{r}
#| label: mixed effect model

#removing double xylem as they will bias the size estimate. then fitting a model with estimates of mean xylem vessel area for each treatment combo

data_model <- data |>
  filter(double_xylem == 0) # remove double xylem from xylem vessel size estimates

model <- lmer(sqrt(Area) ~ year * age_class * nin_type +  
                circ +
                subset_damage + 
                (1 | plant), 
              data = data_model)

pred_mod <- ggpredict(model, terms = c("year"))

pred_mod
plot(pred_mod)
```

```{r}
summary(model)
```

```{r}
VarCorr(model)
```

```{r}
res <- residuals(model)
plot(res)
```

```{r}
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)
```

```{r}
#| label: mixed effect model prediction and raw values

#since i have used a sqrt transform on the dataset, the std.error gets kind of unreliable. are instead using confidence intervals

mixed_vs_raw <- ggplot() +  
  geom_point(data = data, 
             aes(x = age_class, y = means_treatment, color = nin_type), 
             shape = 1, 
             size = 3, 
             position = position_dodge(0.2)) + 
  geom_point(data = pred_mod, 
             aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group), 
             shape = 2, 
             size = 4, 
             position = position_dodge(0.2)) + 
  geom_errorbar(data = pred_mod, 
                aes(x = x, 
                    ymin = predicted-conf.low, 
                    ymax = predicted+conf.high, 
                    color = group), 
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.2)) + 
  labs(x = "Age class", 
       y = "Mean xylem vessel area in µm²") + 
  guides(color = guide_legend("NiN Type")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkslategrey", "deepskyblue4", "lightskyblue")) 

mixed_vs_raw

ggsave("plots/Mixed_effects_vs_raw_averages.png", mixed_vs_raw)

```

```{r}
anova(model, type = 3) #using type 3 as the drop1 output deemed the age_class:nin_type interaction significant
```
